summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by NXT Energy Solutions Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes financial statements, management's discussion and analysis, and certifications. No special-situation transaction (e.g., merger, tender offer, spin-off, or activist campaign) is described. The filing is a routine periodic report. The financial statements show a net loss of $2.4 million for the period. As a non-US issuer, this Form 6-K serves as the equivalent of a quarterly report on Form 10-Q. There are no deal terms to note.
